resources.scope: Study worker plus six recorded native services; includes their concurrent public traffic. Excludes OS and unrecorded processes. Sampled memory maxima are not continuous peaks.

limitations: No model fit, prediction evaluation, Glicko recomputation or external-strength validation is performed.
Recorded roster seeds are historical priors; original identities had an anchor correction and earlier earned games. Actual checkpoint initial ratings define this run drift.
Excess native game-count increments are unattributed here; they may include public human games and need separate native evidence.
Native snapshots and rated-update flags are reconciled, but this does not independently query or prove database persistence.
Event timestamps mark driver observations, not exact native admission/completion instants. Stage wall-clock spans can overlap.
Study-only concurrency is observed at submissions; public-human concurrency and true continuous peaks are not reconstructed.
Resource intervals cover their observed sample window, not necessarily the whole run. CPU means are time weighted; percentiles are unweighted interval observations.
Glicko RD/nonprovisional status measures model-relative uncertainty, not guaranteed accuracy or Lichess scale alignment.
